messages.subject: stan models as character strings
parts:
Hi, I keep seeing people with Stan models as character strings. This is bad practice. Can we remove any such instances in our help files? People must be getting this bad idea from somewhere.
A

messages.author: 20758fda448fdbda
messages.subject: Re: stan models as character strings
parts:
On Monday, August 15, 2016 at 6:48:07 PM UTC-4, Andrew Gelman wrote:
> Hi, I keep seeing people with Stan models as character strings. This is bad practice. Can we remove any such instances in our help files? People must be getting this bad idea from somewhere.
> A

Rcpp allows for models to be passed as character strings instead of read in as stand alone files. They may be getting it from there.

Also, IIRC, one of the original help webpages dealing with installation of rstan showed one of the 8schools models as a string as well. The current github help does not show it that way now.
